_comment: Wired-or-deleted allowlist (Remediation PR-13). scripts/check-wired-modules.js enforces it; test/wiredModules.test.js runs it in CI. A services/*.js unreachable from production must be WIRED, DELETED, or listed here. Two categories: `modules` = staged for imminent wiring (each REQUIRES `expires` YYYY-MM-DD + `roadmap`; an expired entry FAILS CI so staging can never be permanent; keep small — target <= 8); `testOnly` = production-unreachable BY DESIGN because it is test/CI tooling (needs `reason`, never expires).
